review.why: Builds and troubleshoots Cloudflare K2 streams, durable logs for decoupling event producers and consumers, by pointing to current docs by task.
review.summary: Describes K2 as a durable log and tells the agent to retrieve current docs before giving setup, code, limits or pricing. A table maps tasks (create a stream, concepts, configuration, produce, consume, limits) to doc pages and what to check. It points to the Basin skill for SQL delivery and to Queues for task processing.
strengths: Docs are the source of truth, including for limits and pricing
Says to state when availability or pricing is not yet published
cautions: Thin: mostly a link table, and the product may still be in preview
